decisionsTaken.decision: census exemptions documented in-test: BACK and FRONT leaves enter the band but are cut by the band's own datum - they are not kawalki

findings.found: the raked TOP's meta.elevation was stated in the OLD envelope frame - every wall elevation drew the raked roof shifted by faceLen-span and ~2 mm low. Latent since T47; caught by F1.8's three-surface parity assert; FIXED in F1 (elevation restated in the piece's own box frame).
at extreme rakes a shaker door's recess can go triangular and is emitted with NO warning - written up during the T46-F4 amendment; out of tonight's scope, not fixed. A Check rule is the natural home.

F5's premise 'the existing per-cabinet left/right LED icons drop their selected-only gate' named icons that did not exist in the scene - no LED icon had ever been drawn on a unit. Built new (canvas-sprite pills, gated on the panel), which is more than the spec's 'a visibility condition and nothing else' but less than a redesign; the owner's intent (icons visible with the panel open) is what shipped.

the owner's malutki kawalek at the peak lived in TWO places: the sub-G capped roof stub (roofBoards emitted it when the ceiling cap crossed inside G of the peak side) and a run-strip sliver at the same crossing (the strip read the CAPPED roof line). Both graves named in the F2 commit; the band census is now a permanent test.
